user.title: Connect your JK BMS units
user.description:
How are the BMS units connected?

**What you need:** a USB-RS485 adapter (preferably FTDI FT232R) or an RS485 network gateway, and a CAT5/6 cable cut open at one end: RJ45 **pin 1 = B (D−)**, **pin 2 = A (D+)**, **pin 3 = GND** (white-orange, orange, white-green).

**Where:** the free **RS485-2** (parallel) socket on the communication board of the first or last pack — not CAN / RS485-1, that one goes to the inverter. Every pack needs its own DIP address.

settings.title: Update interval
settings.description:
The interval is only used when Home Assistant polls the BMS units itself; with a master BMS (address 0) the master sets the pace.

**Allow changing BMS settings** adds switches (charge, discharge, balance) and the protection settings, and makes the settings card editable. Changes go straight into the BMS: only change what you understand. With a master BMS the integration sends a change in a quiet moment on the bus and checks that the BMS confirms it.

rescan.title: Search again
rescan.description: Pauses reading for up to 40 seconds and searches the bus. Use this after adding a pack or changing a DIP address. Packs that are not found stay, so a pack that is switched off is not lost.
